title: Restart a Robot Using the Robot Selection Panel (Robot ID/Select + Restart Button)
summary: Use the robot selection panel to enter/select a robot ID, press the panel’s Restart button, then verify the restarted robot is displayed on the map after the restart/start sequence.
when_to_use: When a specific robot needs to be restarted from the robot selection panel and you must confirm it returns to expected map visibility after the restart/start cycle.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the restart from the robot selection panel (enter/select robot ID, click Restart) and verify the robot’s map visibility after the restart cycle.
safety_notes: If the robot does not appear on the map as expected because it cannot see a label (flashing blue), the source indicates you must E stop the system and physically push the robot onto the label; only perform this follow-on recovery if you can do it safely.
access_or_tools_needed: Robot selection panel (robot ID entry / robot selection)
Map display to verify robot visibility

system_preconditions: You can view the robot selection panel and the map display used to confirm robot visibility.

visual_references.description: Restart robot panel workflow: enter/select robot ID, click Restart, and expected post-start map display; includes the note about label/QR recognition affecting map visibility.

steps.title: Enter the corresponding robot ID or select the robot on the robot selection panel
steps.purpose: Choose the specific robot that will be restarted.
steps.instruction: On the robot selection panel, enter the corresponding robot ID or select the robot you want to restart.
steps.expected_result: The intended robot is selected on the robot selection panel (so the Restart action will apply to that robot).
steps.healthy_condition: You can identify the selected robot on the panel (robot selection is active/targeted).
steps.failure_condition: You cannot confidently select the intended robot (wrong robot selected), or the robot you intended to restart is not the one targeted for the Restart action.

actions.label: Select robot by ID or click robot
actions.exact_action: Enter the corresponding robot Id or select the robot

source_evidence.quote_or_paraphrase: Transcript: 'you put in the ID or you select the robot that you're interested in restarting.' OCR: 'Enter the corresponding robot Id or select the robot'.

steps.title: Click the "Restart" button on the panel
steps.purpose: Trigger the restart cycle for the selected robot.
steps.instruction: Click the "Restart" button on the robot restart panel.
steps.expected_result: The restart cycle begins for the selected robot.
steps.healthy_condition: The system accepts the restart action for the selected robot (restart sequence is initiated).
steps.failure_condition: The restart action does not start (no restart cycle observed) or the wrong robot appears to be affected.

source_evidence.quote_or_paraphrase: Transcript: 'You press the restart button on this panel over here and it will restart.' OCR: 'Click "Restart"'.

steps.title: Wait for the robot to restart (restart point or QR code cell) and complete the restart/start sequence
steps.purpose: Allow the robot to complete its restart cycle so it can resume and be recognized for map display.
steps.instruction: Wait for the robot to restart. The source notes the robot will restart at the restart point or on the QR code cell.
steps.expected_result: The robot completes the restart/start sequence and is positioned such that it can be displayed on the map.
steps.healthy_condition: After starting, the robot that has been positioned is displayed on the map.
steps.failure_condition: After restart, the robot does not snap back onto the map automatically because it cannot see a label (source indicates this is associated with a flashing blue label indicator).

actions.label: Observe restart completion and map readiness
actions.exact_action: Wait for the robot to restart (it is at the restart point or on the QR code cell)

stop_or_escalate_if: If the robot does not appear on the map as expected and you cannot safely perform the follow-on recovery described by the source (E stop + physical action), stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_paraphrase: OCR: 'The robot will restart (it is at the restart point or on the QR code cell).' Transcript: 'After starting, the robot that has been positioned will be displayed on the map.'

Transcript: 'If your robot is stopped for some reason in between two labels and you perform a restart, it will not snap back onto the map automatically. ... It's because it can't see a label and you'll see that flashing blue sign.'

steps.title: Confirm the restarted robot is displayed on the map
steps.purpose: Verify the restart achieved the expected system state (map visibility).
steps.instruction: After starting, check the map display to confirm the robot that was positioned is displayed.
steps.expected_result: The selected robot is displayed on the map after the restart/start sequence.
steps.healthy_condition: The robot appears on the map (map visibility matches the restarted/positioned robot).
steps.failure_condition: The robot is not displayed on the map after restart (especially if it was restarted between labels and cannot see a label).

actions.label: Verify robot visibility on map
actions.exact_action: After starting, confirm the robot ... is displayed on the map

stop_or_escalate_if: If the robot does not appear on the map as expected and you cannot safely perform the follow-on recovery described by the source (E stop the system, walk into the floor, push the robot onto the label, then clear the E stop), stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_paraphrase: OCR: 'After starting, the robot that has been positioned will be displayed on the map.' Transcript: 'After starting, the robot that has been positioned will be displayed on the map itself.'

success_criteria: The selected robot restarts and is displayed on the map after the restart/start sequence.
healthy_conditions: After starting, the robot that has been positioned is displayed on the map.
failure_conditions: Robot does not snap back onto the map automatically after restart because it cannot see a label (flashing blue label indicator described by the source).
escalation_guidance: If the robot does not appear on the map as expected and you cannot safely perform the source-described follow-on recovery (E stop the system, physically push the robot onto the label, then clear the E stop), stop and escalate.
